claims.subject: sorin_markov

evidence.quote: He was there when I was created, the man who stood over me that first instant when I came into being.
"You created me to ensure that all wickedness meets its demise," I say.

claims.summary: Sorin Markov created Avacyn as Innistrad's protector.
claims.limitation: Narrated in Avacyn's own first-person voice.

claims.subject: sorin_markov

evidence.quote: Fumes rose from the burnt place on the floor, drifting up through shafts of light from one of the cathedral's skylights. Avacyn was no more.
"I had to," Sorin whispered.

claims.summary: Sorin unmade Avacyn with a reversed ritual, revoking the gift that made her.

claims.subject: sorin_markov

evidence.quote: Sorin Markov, I condemn you as the greatest evil of this world.

claims.summary: Maddened, Avacyn condemned Sorin as the greatest evil of Innistrad before he unmade her.
claims.limitation: Avacyn's condemnation came during her madness.

claims.subject: nahiri

evidence.quote: The stone tightened in on him until it had him in its grasp.
And the next moment, Nahiri planeswalked away from Innistrad, leaving Sorin to the fate of his world.

claims.summary: At Markov Manor, Nahiri encased Sorin in stone and planeswalked away.

claims.subject: nahiri

evidence.quote: Thanks to Nahiri's machinations, the Eldrazi titan Emrakul has been unleashed on Innistrad.

claims.summary: Nahiri's machinations unleashed Emrakul on Innistrad.
claims.limitation: The page's lead-in summary credits her 'machinations'; the mechanism is told elsewhere.

claims.subject: olivia_voldaren

evidence.quote: "Even if I could, why? Avacyn is dead. Nahiri has been driven off. Our bargain is fulfilled." She chuckled cruelly.
I rather like the sound of 'Olivia, Lord of Innistrad.'

claims.summary: Olivia refused to free the imprisoned Sorin once their bargain was fulfilled, taking his sword.

claims.subject: tamiyo

evidence.quote: Not the Helvault, Tamiyo responded. Where the Helvault came from. The moon. A silver moon. I have a binding spell.
In that moon's depths was the most powerful and destructive force any of them had ever encountered.

claims.summary: Tamiyo's binding spell, linked to Emrakul with Jace's help, bound Emrakul inside Innistrad's silver moon.
claims.limitation: The binding was a group effort (Jace attached the spell, and the text turns to Nissa for its power).

claims.subject: emrakul

evidence.quote: In that moon's depths was the most powerful and destructive force any of them had ever encountered.

claims.summary: After The Promised End, Emrakul is held in the depths of Innistrad's moon.

claims.subject: liliana_vess

evidence.quote: She was now a member of the Gatewatch. Futures unfolded in her mind, full of promise and ambition.

claims.summary: Liliana swore an oath and joined the Gatewatch after Emrakul was bound.
claims.limitation: Her oath was partly insincere by her own account.

claims.subject: jace_beleren

evidence.quote: Jace Beleren has come to Innistrad searching for the vampire lord Sorin Markov, who he hopes can help him unravel a puzzle.

claims.summary: Jace came to Innistrad looking for Sorin Markov.
claims.limitation: From the episode's lead-in recap.

claims.subject: sorin_markov

evidence.quote: Jace has come to Innistrad in search of Sorin Markov, one of the three Planeswalkers who imprisoned the Eldrazi on Zendikar thousands of years ago.

claims.summary: Sorin was one of the three Planeswalkers who imprisoned the Eldrazi on Zendikar thousands of years ago.
claims.limitation: From the episode's lead-in recap; the other two are not named in this quote.

claims.subject: markov_manor

evidence.quote: Despite the dire warnings of Liliana Vess, he has made his way to Markov Manor, ancestral home of the vampire Planeswalker.

claims.summary: Markov Manor is Sorin's ancestral home.

claims.subject: jace_beleren

evidence.quote: His investigation brought him to the twisted remains of Markov Manor, where he discovered a journal amid the rubble.

claims.summary: Jace found a research journal in the ruins of Markov Manor.

claims.subject: tamiyo

evidence.quote: As it happens, the journal's author, the moonfolk Planeswalker called Tamiyo, is several steps ahead of him....

claims.summary: The journal Jace followed was written by the moonfolk Planeswalker Tamiyo.

claims.subject: sorin_markov

evidence.quote: Though shunned by his own kind, he hopes to gather the aid of the vampires to confront the threat that has come to Innistrad.
His search has brought him to the remote estate of the powerful Olivia Voldaren.

claims.summary: Sorin went to Olivia Voldaren's estate seeking vampire aid against the threat to Innistrad.

claims.subject: helvault

evidence.quote: The Helvault—it had come from the plane's silver moon, and it had taken great effort for Sorin to bring it here.

claims.summary: The Helvault came from Innistrad's silver moon; Sorin brought it to Innistrad.

claims.subject: liliana_vess

evidence.quote: With it, she had killed two demons, lords among their kind.

claims.summary: Liliana used the Chain Veil to kill two of the demon lords who held her contract.
claims.limitation: 'it' refers to the Chain Veil named in the preceding sentence; the demons are not named in this quote.

claims.subject: odric

evidence.quote: Odric, a champion of the church, captured Gisa and held her imprisoned in Rider's Lock.

claims.summary: After the siege of Thraben, Odric captured Gisa and held her in Rider's Lock.
claims.limitation: From the episode's lead-in recap.

claims.subject: gisa

evidence.quote: Each hoping to outdo the other in their mad sibling rivalry, Gisa and Geralf besieged the city of Thraben with their zombie armies, sending wave after wave of unhallowed creatures at the holy city.

claims.summary: The necromancer siblings Gisa and Geralf, rivals, besieged Thraben with their zombie armies.

claims.subject: thalia

evidence.quote: Scores of civilians and cathars fell in Thraben's defense, and the head of the church of Avacyn—Lunarch Mikaeus—was killed in the assault before Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, drove the monsters back.

claims.summary: Thalia drove the zombie armies back from Thraben.

claims.subject: thalia

evidence.quote: And while the Planeswalker threatened the life of every soldier under her command, Thalia finally acquiesced to her terrible demand: she sundered the Helvault, releasing all the demons it had contained—as well as the archangel Avacyn.

claims.summary: Under Liliana's threat, Thalia sundered the Helvault, releasing its demons and Avacyn.
claims.limitation: From the lead-in recap of the earlier Innistrad storyline.

claims.subject: odric

evidence.quote: He earned a seat on the council as a representative of the cathars, without an actual vote on council matters.

claims.summary: Odric sat on the new Lunarch Council as the cathars' non-voting representative.
claims.limitation: 'He' is Odric, named in the preceding sentence of the recap.

claims.subject: kellan_boldt

evidence.quote: And Kellan Boldt, master apprentice and aspirant elite, first son and heir to the Duchy of Kelsh, schooled in the art by Archmage Ghavos, now crumbled to his knees in utter defeat.

claims.summary: Kellan Boldt, heir to the Duchy of Kelsh, was schooled in magic by Archmage Ghavos.
claims.limitation: Side story; not the Eldraine character Kellan.

claims.subject: arlinn_kord

evidence.quote: A lycanthrope could not be an archmage of Goldnight, and Arlinn had to become an archmage of Goldnight.
Her fingers closed around the mantle of the archmage of Goldnight.

claims.summary: In a flashback, Arlinn, a secret lycanthrope, sought and took up the mantle of an archmage of Goldnight.
claims.limitation: The 'Years Ago' flashback; the quotes show the ceremony and mantle, and her status after it is told elsewhere in the episode.

claims.subject: arlinn_kord

evidence.quote: She was the protector of the Ulvenwald.

claims.summary: Arlinn sees herself as the protector of the Ulvenwald.
claims.limitation: Close third-person narration from Arlinn's point of view.

claims.subject: sorin_markov

evidence.quote: Then the Helvault claimed her, and she vanished into a darkness vast and total.
The last time Nahiri had seen Sorin, he had been the last thing she saw in the world before the solitude of the Helvault consumed her.

claims.summary: A thousand years ago, Sorin sealed Nahiri inside the Helvault.

claims.subject: sorin_markov

evidence.quote: But the Eldrazi nearly escaped over a thousand years ago, and neither Sorin nor Ugin came.

claims.summary: When the Eldrazi nearly escaped, neither Sorin nor Ugin came to Nahiri's aid.
claims.limitation: From the lead-in recap.

claims.subject: emrakul

evidence.quote: Now the plane is without a protector, exposed to threats both of the world and from beyond—exactly as Nahiri wants it.
From below, there was a rumbling. And then Emrakul rose.

claims.summary: With Avacyn dead, Emrakul rose on Innistrad, as Nahiri intended.
claims.limitation: The quotes give the outcome; Nahiri's method is told across EMN.

claims.subject: gisela

evidence.quote: That meant the fused angel-thing contained Bruna and Gisela, the archangels of the other two hosts.

claims.summary: Gisela was fused with Bruna into one angel, Brisela.

claims.subject: bruna

evidence.quote: That meant the fused angel-thing contained Bruna and Gisela, the archangels of the other two hosts.

claims.summary: Bruna was fused with Gisela into one angel, Brisela.
claims.limitation: The name Brisela is shown only in the art caption 'Brisela, Voice of Nightmares'.

claims.subject: thalia

evidence.quote: Thalia had allowed herself to become a vessel for the saint's geist, and armed with that sacred power, she had led a ragtag band of rebellious soldiers, cathars, and clergy in carrying on the church's mission despite the corruption at its heart.

claims.summary: Thalia became a vessel for Saint Traft's geist and led the Order of Saint Traft.
claims.limitation: From the lead-in recap.

claims.subject: jace_beleren

evidence.quote: Realizing the enormity of the situation, he planeswalked to Zendikar to rally the Gatewatch; it would take all of them to destroy the eldritch monstrosity.

claims.summary: After seeing Emrakul, Jace went to Zendikar to bring the Gatewatch to Innistrad.
claims.limitation: From the lead-in recap.

claims.subject: halana

evidence.quote: Halana and Alena are trackers, hunters, and protectors who live in the depths of the dark woods that border the edges of Kessig province—the woods known as the Ulvenwald.

claims.summary: Halana and Alena are trackers and protectors of the Ulvenwald.

claims.subject: alena

evidence.quote: Halana and Alena are trackers, hunters, and protectors who live in the depths of the dark woods that border the edges of Kessig province—the woods known as the Ulvenwald.

claims.summary: Alena is, with Halana, a tracker and protector of the Ulvenwald.

claims.subject: avacyn

evidence.quote: The vampires are in retreat, and the werewolf curse has been alleviated by the Cursemute, a magical edict from Avacyn that gave afflicted lycanthropes the choice either to become wolfir, wolven servants of Avacyn, or, in rarer cases, to be fully cured.

claims.summary: Avacyn's Cursemute let werewolves become wolfir or, rarely, be cured.
claims.limitation: The lead-in describes the time before Avacyn's madness.

claims.subject: lake_zhava

evidence.quote: Dark and deep, Lake Zhava lies in the highlands of Nephalia, near the border with Gavony.

claims.summary: Lake Zhava lies in Nephalia's highlands, near Gavony.

remaining: Targeted, not exhaustive: one or two claims per episode; most episodes hold more relationships than are extracted here
Tamiyo's journal entries, the Markov Manor puzzle and the Thraben battle details are only summarized
